thread:
maria: Quick Q — planning to change SIEM export retention defaults. Proposal: 90d for high-volume operational logs, 365d for security/audit logs, and 540d (18mo) for incident evidence buckets. Thoughts?

ben: Sounds fine but we need to account for cost. Can we tier older logs to compressed cold storage and keep indices only for 90d?

raj: Agree on tiering. Also: exports must be KMS-wrapped and access via a proxy role. If we increase audit retention to 365d we should limit who can request raw exports. Suggest new RBAC: `log_query` (read+kibana), `export_request` (submit export that requires 2 approvers).

avani: @maria +1 on RBAC. From compliance side: retention for payment telemetry may need 7 years for some customers — we need per-customer overrides. Also add an approval flow with @legal in the loop for extended retention.

maria: Good points. New idea: ship a standard request template so all export requests include justification, retention duration, data scope, and business owner. Example template:

```
Export request
- requestor: <email>
- business_owner: <team>
- reason: incident / legal / analytics
- datasets: auth_logs, inference_trace
- time_range: 2025-02-01 -> 2025-02-28
- retention_needed: 540d
- approvers_needed: security, legal
```

ben: Can we enforce templating at the API layer? e.g., POST /exports must include `justification` and `approved_by` fields before it queues for approval. Also add audit log event `export.request.created` that records KMS key id and requester.

raj: Technical constraints: the exporter uses KMS wrapping with envelope keys. We'll add metadata tags to S3 objects: `export_request_ts`, `export_id`, `kms_key_alias`. That will make later searches easier without full decryption.

security-bot: new policy draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/policies/retention-draft — automatic pin.

avani: Also flag for vuln triage: when an incident needs long-term artifacts, triage owner should open an Evidence Retention ticket with justification + TTL. That ticket triggers a scoped JIT grant to a `forensics` role and sets object lifecycle to the TTL.

maria: Action items: (1) raj to prototype request API + S3 tags, (2) ben to add `export.request.created` audit event, (3) avani to confirm legal retention exceptions, (4) I'll draft RBAC changes and approval flow. I'll put PR up by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

ben: acked.

raj: I'll start on the prototype this afternoon.

avani: will ping legal. :+1:
